limits: Encoded payload assumes one E4M3 byte per weight and one E8M0 byte per 32 weights.
Actual Marlin scale representation, layout padding and workspace must be measured; this is not an allocated-memory result.
The C1 attribution is 9.08/9.94 ms of kernel-time sums, not saved wall time.
C8/C16 verification widths and kernel choices are unmeasured for this proposed variant.
Quantization may change DFlash acceptance; end-to-end throughput needs its own measurement.
